rationale: Retain the complete pinned integer-range implementation. Adapt JavaScript Error construction to the typed portable runtime error, and replace unchecked-min at the bounded chunk size with the equivalent comparison, preserving the exact result for nonnegative count and 32. As Clojure's LongRange, iteration follows the exact count and steps with unchecked arithmetic, which never overflows inside the range, so a range ending near Long/MAX_VALUE or MIN_VALUE works (#335). Iteration goes through the seq.
